The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='*PurchaseOrder*'` and it passed with no output. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

In `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517), I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. This matches how the per-quarter purchase-order report filters. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged. I also changed the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".
